name: Berry Hill

dates.note: Three dates on the record. The Virginia DHR: 'erected in 1842-44 for James Coles Bruce'; the node: begun 1842, year 1844; the 1930s HABS form: 'Date of Erection: 1835-1840'; the Wikipedia infobox: 'Built 1839' and the text 'transformed c. 1839'. Recorded as the state register states it, the others kept in their own quotes and notes.

quotes.text: BERRY HILL (Residence) Halifax County, Virginia Owner: Malcolm G. Bruce Date of Erection: 1835-1840 Architect: Builder: Present Condition: Excellent Number of Stories.: Two and Basement Materials of Construction: Brick, stuccoed

note: Written 4 Sep 2026. The 1930s form is an index card: storeys, material and a date that the state register and the node both place five to nine years later. `greek-revival-southern-plantation` also names this building; see the Andalusia note.
